description: Add a CI ratchet for @shadcn/lint warnings on the app components/ui folders and for the count of local shadcn component copies. Both counts compare with a committed baseline and fail only when a count goes up. Step 1 of PM order A-32.
deviation_notes: Two of the six @shadcn/lint rules are out: no-raw-colors and no-unknown-classes need a Tailwind theme build, and the build worker times out for primary-advantage and reading-advantage at every budget up to 120 s. The bundled fallback grammar is not stable enough for a ratchet, so the gate counts the four rules that do not read the theme. The lockfile also rewrites the eslint-config-next peer suffix and minimatch 10.2.5 to 10.2.6 through the new optional peer. The full scripts/ci suite has one pre-existing failure (W-23, cd-www-reading-advantage.yml pin), which this track does not touch.
